problems.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
problems.proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  let lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case app l r il ir =>
    right
    rcases il rfl with vl | ⟨t', hl⟩
    · rcases ir rfl with vr | ⟨t', hr⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
        exact ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ vl hr⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 hl⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨t', h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc sub.wf.2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp sub.wf.2.1.lc h⟩
  case let' ih _ =>
    right
    have hb := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨t', h⟩ <;>
      solve_by_elim [Exists.intro, Red.let_body, Red.let_bind]
  case inl ih | inr ih =>
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨_, h⟩ <;>
      solve_by_elim [Or.inl, Or.inr, Exists.intro, Value.inl, Value.inr, Red.inl, Red.inr]
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, hb₂, hb₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨t', h⟩
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v
      all_goals cases v
      all_goals apply_rules [Exists.intro, Term.Red.case_inl, Term.Red.case_inr]
    · exact ⟨_, .case h hb₂ hb₃⟩
  all_goals first
  | left; constructor; exact lc
  | rename_i ih; exact ih rfl

problems.name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
problems.proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => use a₂, h₂, .refl a₂
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' par.par iha ihb _ _ ha'' hb'' =>
    rcases iha ha'', ihb hb'' with ⟨⟨_, ha⟩, ⟨_, hb⟩⟩
    exact ⟨_, ha.1.par hb.1, ha.2.par hb.2⟩
  case' par.red_I b' _ _ ha' _ =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha'
    use b', .red_I b'
  case' par.red_K ha' _ | red_K.par ha' _ =>
    obtain ⟨k, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha'
    refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> first | assumption | constructor
  case' par.red_S hb' _ _ _ ha' _ | red_S.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, ha, hc, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha'
    have hj := (ha.par hb').par (hc.par hb')
    first
    | exact ⟨_, hj, .red_S ..⟩
    | exact ⟨_, .red_S .., hj⟩
  case' red_I.par a₁' hc ha =>
    cases I_irreducible _ hc
    use a₁', ha, .red_I _
  all_goals exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩

problems.name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
problems.proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro _ _ (h | h) μ <;> apply (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp <;> intro f s t <;>
    repeat' first
    | exact (f _ ‹_›).imp fun _ => And.imp (by first | exact id | exact Tr.choiceL) ChoiceBisim.bisim
    | exact ⟨s, Tr.choiceR ‹_›, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | cases t
